WITH date_filters AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy > 4 AND d_moy <= 10 AND d_year = 1999
)
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name,
       MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store
JOIN store_sales ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
JOIN date_filters d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
                     AND d1.d_moy = 4
                     AND d1.d_year = 1999
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk
JOIN store_returns ON ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
                  AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
                  AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
JOIN date_filters d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr_returned_date_sk
                     AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
                     AND d2.d_year = 1999
JOIN catalog_sales ON sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk
                  AND sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk
JOIN date_filters d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk
                     AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
                     AND d3.d_year = 1999
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
